identity.title: Emperor of the Crystal Tower (graphic novel)

leadText: (Japanese: 結晶塔の帝王エンテイ Emperor of the Crystal Tower) is a graphic novel published by Shogakukan in Japan. It is a manga-style book (often branded as "Animation Comics" or "Ani-Manga") which retells the plotlines of Spell of the Unown: Entei and Pikachu & Pichu using screenshots from both films. The book credits Hideki Sonoda and Takeshi Shudō as the authors.
